output.summary: Three independent one-line behaviour changes in unrelated modules: cart totals are rounded, the welcome message wording changes, and the default log level moves from debug to info. No code edges link them.

groups.title: cartTotal rounds to cents
groups.description: cartTotal now rounds the sum to two decimals. Check that rounding at this point is intended and that callers don't also round.

groups.title: Default log level becomes info
groups.description: logLevel falls back to 'info' instead of 'debug' when LOG_LEVEL is unset. Confirm that quieter default is intended for all environments.

groups.title: Welcome message wording changes
groups.description: welcomeMessage now reads 'Welcome back' with an exclamation mark. It looks unrelated to the other changes; check that tests or translations depending on the old text are updated.
